answers.sql: SELECT high + (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM guidance_adjustments WHERE fiscal_period = 'Q2FY2025') FROM guidance WHERE fiscal_period = 'Q2FY2025'

SELECT (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end = '2024-11-30' AND months = 3 AND measure = 'Non-GAAP diluted EPS') - (SELECT high + (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM guidance_adjustments WHERE fiscal_period = 'Q2FY2025') FROM guidance WHERE fiscal_period = 'Q2FY2025')

SELECT (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end = '2024-11-30' AND months = 3 AND category = 'Operating expense') - (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end = '2024-11-30' AND months = 3 AND category = 'Income tax expense')

SELECT (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end = '2024-11-30' AND months = 3 AND measure = 'Net income') + (SELECT (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end = '2024-11-30' AND months = 3 AND category = 'Operating expense') - (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end = '2024-11-30' AND months = 3 AND category = 'Income tax expense'))

SELECT (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end = '2024-11-30' AND months = 3 AND measure = 'Non-GAAP net income') / (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end = '2024-11-30' AND months = 3 AND measure = 'Total revenues') * 100
